correctness.rationale: Proposition 5.1 of arXiv:2610.04382v1 realizes the finite list \(c,c^2,\ldots,c^m\) as Reidemeister coordinates for one homeomorphism with trivial loop braid, where \(c=[x_1,x_2]\). Every power has zero abelianization, hence zero linking vector. With trivial loop braid, Theorem 4.6 reduces Nielsen equivalence to ordinary conjugacy in \(F_n\). The words \(c^j\) are cyclically reduced with lengths \(4j\), so distinct powers are nonconjugate. Quantifiers and the limitation to \(n\ge2\) are explicit.

value.rationale: The recent source motivates linking data as an accessible abelianized shadow of Nielsen classes and exhibits one two-class failure of completeness. Showing that the zero-linking fiber can be arbitrarily large changes that qualitative warning into a sharp boundary statement: no finite multiplicity bound can be recovered from linking data, even in the simplest ambient loop-braid sector. This is a natural structural limitation of the new invariant framework, not an arbitrary parameter slice or a table recomputation.
